reply.text:
Holt here. Wanting to build strength at 12 is a good instinct, and I'm glad you're asking about it. Getting "huge" isn't really the goal at your age, though. Your body is still growing, and what works best right now is learning good form, getting stronger with moderate weights, and building the habit of showing up. Bodyweight work like push-ups, squats, lunges and rows, plus plenty of sleep and eating enough food to fuel your training, will do far more for you than chasing size.

Before you start any lifting program, have a parent or guardian talk to your doctor, and ideally work with a qualified coach who can watch your form in person. Once you have that okay, tell me what equipment you have and how many days a week you can train, and we'll go from there.
